test_hermes_time_now: test hermes_time.now() returns a timezone-aware datetime for a valid IANA timezone like Asia/Kolkata
test_hermes_time_get_timezone: test hermes_time.get_timezone() returns a ZoneInfo object for a valid timezone or None when empty
test_execute_code_tz_injection: test execute_code child process receives the TZ environment variable when HERMES_TIMEZONE is configured
test_cron_parse_schedule: test cron.jobs.parse_schedule() produces a timezone-aware run_at timestamp from an interval string
test_cron_ensure_aware: test cron.jobs._ensure_aware() correctly converts naive datetimes to timezone-aware using system-local interpretation
